newsitem.title: USA: Xpedite names De Vita VP/operations.
newsitem.headline: Xpedite names De Vita VP/operations.

text.p: Xpedite Systems Inc said Monday it had promoted Vincent De Vita to the newly created position of vice-president/operations, where he will be responsible for the day-to-day operations of all systems and networks.

De Vita previously served as director of international operations for Xpedite Systems, and before that as chief operating officer of ViTel International Inc, an international telecommunications company that was acquired by Xpedite in November 1995.
